 WPDE is proud to serve as the local draw station for the South Carolina Education Lottery. Since ticket sales began in 2002, the Lottery has transferred more than $9.5 billion for education in South Carolina. Proceeds help support scholarships, grants, tuition assistance and K–12 programs; the General Assembly decides how the funds are appropriated.
 Winning numbers are unofficial until verified by the South Carolina Education Lottery.
